text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered -> PD-7891. inference-gateway-usw2 5xx-rate breached (5m avg 3.2% > threshold 1.0%). Auto-page fired to oncall rotation. link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-7891

pagerduty: Page sent to rotation: sam (primary oncall). Escalation policy: inference-prod.

sam: acked. I'm oncall and looking. opening grafana and k8s.

priya: joining — I can see kvcache_eviction spikes + gateway-02 pod restarts around 23:07 UTC.

sam: running quick log tail to confirm: ```kubectl -n inference logs deployment/gateway-02 --tail=200```

matt: I see a lot of upstream connection resets from envoy -> modelpool. 502 + 504s, mostly concurrent. Could be backlog / worker exhaustion.

lina: support: CS flagged 3 customers reporting failed embeddings calls (high latency then 5xx). Tickets linked in #support.

sam: plan: (1) throttle/shift weight off gateway-02, (2) scale gateway replicas + model workers, (3) monitor 5xx rate. Doing step 1 now.

sam: kubectl patch svc inference-gateway -n infra -p '{"spec":{"sessionAffinity":"None"}}' && envoy-ctl route-weight set inference-gateway-02 0.8

incident-bot: Alert update: 5xx rate dropped to 1.1% (5m avg). :rotating_light:

priya: trend improving but still seeing occasional 504s. kvcache miss rate still elevated. suspect cache thrash from recent rollout + longer sequences.

matt: I'm increasing modelpool-usw2 WORKER_COUNT from 8 -> 12 and enabling cache warmup. Command: ```kubectl set env deployment/modelpool --env "WORKERS=12" -n models```

lina: posting an interim customer update: "We're investigating increased 5xxs for generation/embeddings in US-WEST2; engineers are actively mitigating. We'll update within 30m."

sam: scaled gateway replicas to 6: ```kubectl scale deploy/gateway --replicas=6 -n inference```. Also temporarily reduced burst rate at the L7 layer.

matt: enabling soft-fallback to older model variant for embeddings route -> routing rule applied: embeddings -> model-v1 (20% traffic).

incident-bot: PD update: PD-7891 acknowledged by sam at 1756789050.

priya: metrics: 5xx now ~0.4% (5m avg). p50/p95 latencies back within normal. cache miss rate slowly returning to baseline.

sam: handing off deeper RCA and post-fix verification to matt. I'm going to grab dinner but will be reachable. matt, please take lead and file a short postmortem. @evan-product loop in CS customers.

matt: taking over. I'll correlate recent rollout changes + cache config, and check if a quantization change bumped memory pressure. Initial hypothesis: rollout + long-seq traffic causing cache churn -> backend retries -> envoy upstream resets.

ev an-product: noted. I'll coordinate support comms and collect affected customer IDs for outreach.

incident-bot: Resolved alert (auto-resolve) at 1756790500. Final 5xx (5m avg) = 0.35%. :white_check_mark:

matt: will keep an eye for 30m, then revert temporary route changes if stable. Adding postmortem item: "cache thrash + rollout cadence -> transient backpressure" and mitigation tasks: improve cache warmup, add surge workers, improve rollout canary for cache-sensitive models.

sam: thanks all. Short blameless postmortem draft incoming. Closing thread after handoff.
